summary: Love and freedom grind against each other in you. You want closeness, and you want the exit, often at the same time. Attractions come on suddenly and can leave just as fast.
body: Love and freedom grind against each other in you. You want closeness, and you want the exit, often at the same time. Attractions come on suddenly and can leave just as fast. You may pull people in with real magnetism, then panic when they get comfortable. That friction is the engine you run on; it pushes you toward a kind of love that doesn't ask you to disappear. The work is staying past the first urge to run, and telling the truth about what you need.
gift: At your best: magnetic, honest, drawn to love that keeps you free.
shadow: The trap: pulling people in, then panicking when they get comfortable.
integration: Let love breathe without making it unreliable. The right connection does not require you to disappear to stay yourself.
do: Stay past the first urge to run
Tell the truth about what you need
Build love that doesn't ask you to shrink
dont: Confuse intensity with the right fit
